questions.stem: 我們需要數位典藏（digital archives）的原因很簡單：無論多麼小心保存紙本文件，它們終究會損壞。
questions.answer: The reason why we need digital archives is simple: no matter how carefully we preserve paper documents, they will eventually be damaged.
accepted_answers: The reason we need digital archives is simple: no matter how carefully paper documents are stored, they will be damaged sooner or later.
The reason why digital archives are needed is simple: no matter how carefully we keep paper documents, they will still be damaged in the end.

questions.stem: 數位典藏（digital archives）保存了許多可能永遠遺失的老照片，這讓年輕一代能看見祖先的生活。
questions.answer: Digital archives have preserved many old photos that might have been lost forever, which lets the younger generation see how their ancestors lived.
accepted_answers: Digital archives have saved many old pictures that might otherwise have been lost forever, which allows young people to see what their ancestors' lives were like.

patterns: 關係代名詞子句（that could have been p.p.）
非限定關係子句（, which 指前面整句）

1.explanation_zh: 「我們需要數位典藏的原因」是「原因」被前面的子句修飾，英文用關係副詞 the reason why + S + V（why 可省略或換成 that），整句的主詞是 the reason，所以寫成 The reason why we need digital archives is simple:。「無論多麼小心保存…」用 no matter how carefully + S + V，副詞 carefully 跟著 how 移到前面，子句維持直述句語序；中文沒寫主詞，英文補上 we（we preserve paper documents），或改成被動 paper documents are preserved。「保存」用 preserve 最貼切，store、keep 也可以。「終究會損壞」是遲早會發生的結果，用 will eventually be damaged（或 sooner or later、in the end）。
evidence: 我們需要數位典藏（digital archives）的原因很簡單
無論多麼小心保存紙本文件
1.strategy_zh: 「…的原因（很簡單）」→ The reason (why) + S + V + is …；「無論多麼＋形容詞／副詞」→ no matter how + adj./adv. + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：我們需要數位典藏的原因很簡單／無論多麼小心／保存紙本文件／它們終究會損壞
標的詞彙：reason（原因）、need（需要）、simple（簡單的）、carefully（小心地）、preserve（保存，也可用 store、keep）、paper（紙本）、document（文件）、eventually（終究）、damage（損壞）
句型框架：The reason why + S + V … is simple: no matter how carefully + S + V …, S + will eventually be p.p.

2.explanation_zh: 「數位典藏保存了…」是到現在為止的成果，用現在完成式 have preserved（也可用現在式 preserve／keep）。「可能永遠遺失的老照片」修飾語在前，英文改成關係子句 old photos that might otherwise have been lost forever：照片是「被遺失」所以用被動，「本來可能」用 might／could (otherwise) have been p.p.。「這讓年輕一代…」的「這」指前面整件事，用非限定關係子句 , which allows the younger generation to …。「看見祖先的生活」可寫成名詞子句 see how their ancestors lived，或 see what their ancestors' lives were like。
evidence: 可能永遠遺失的老照片
這讓年輕一代能看見祖先的生活
2.strategy_zh: 「…的＋名詞」→ 名詞 + that／which 子句（後位修飾）；「…，這讓…」→ , which allows + O + to V。
hints: 切成四段：數位典藏保存了／許多可能永遠遺失的老照片／這讓年輕一代／能看見祖先的生活
標的詞彙：preserve（保存）、photo（照片）、lose（遺失）、forever（永遠）、generation（一代）、see（看見）、ancestor（祖先）、live（生活）
句型框架：S + have p.p. + N + that might (otherwise) have been p.p. …, which lets + O + see／which allows + O + to see how + S + V

traps.zh: 我們需要數位典藏（digital archives）的原因
traps.literal_error: We need digital archives' reason is simple: …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文把修飾語「我們需要數位典藏」放在「原因」前面，英文要把它移到後面，寫成 the reason (why) we need digital archives，再接 is simple。

traps.literal_error: no matter how careful we preserve paper documents
traps.explanation_zh: 「多麼小心」修飾的是動作「保存」，英文用副詞 carefully，而且要跟著 how 移到子句前面：no matter how carefully + S + V。

bonus.text: However carefully paper documents are preserved, time will eventually take its toll on them, which is precisely why digital archives are indispensable.
bonus.explanation_zh: However + 副詞 … 等於 no matter how …；take its toll on …（對…造成損害）是生動的搭配；句尾 , which is precisely why … 用非限定關係子句收尾，把原因和結論接在同一句。

1.restructuring_zh: 「我們需要數位典藏的原因很簡單」中文以「…的原因」當主題，英文把修飾語後移，寫成 The reason (why) we need digital archives is simple，冒號後再接說明的完整子句；「無論多麼小心保存紙本文件」沒有主詞，英文要補上 we，或改成被動 paper documents are preserved。

traps.zh: 可能永遠遺失的老照片
traps.literal_error: many may be lost forever old photos
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「可能永遠遺失的」放在名詞前，英文要改成後位的關係子句 photos that might (otherwise) have been lost forever，而且「遺失」要用被動。
「生活」在這裡是名詞，英文用 lives（或改寫成名詞子句 how their ancestors lived），不要寫成動詞 live。

bonus.text: Thanks to digital archives, countless old photos that might otherwise have been lost are kept safe, giving younger generations a window into their ancestors' lives.
bonus.explanation_zh: Thanks to …（多虧…）開頭點出功勞；句尾 giving … a window into …（讓…一窺…）用分詞片語表結果，a window into 是生動的比喻。

2.restructuring_zh: 「可能永遠遺失的老照片」中文修飾語在前，英文改成後位的關係子句 photos that might otherwise have been lost forever；「這讓…」的「這」指前面整件事，用 , which allows … 接在後面；「看見祖先的生活」可以改寫成名詞子句 how their ancestors lived。

1.translation: The reason we need digital archives is simple: no matter how carefully paper documents are preserved, they will eventually be damaged.
1.explanation_zh: 「我們需要…的原因很簡單」用 The reason (why) we need… is simple，冒號保留中文的說明結構；「無論多麼小心保存」中文沒有主詞，用 no matter how carefully + 被動 are preserved；「終究會損壞」用 will eventually be damaged（也可 deteriorate／fall apart）。

2.translation: Digital archives have preserved many old photos that might have been lost forever, which allows the younger generation to see how their ancestors lived.
2.explanation_zh: 「保存了」是到現在的成果，用現在完成式；「可能永遠遺失的老照片」用限定關係子句，因為照片已被保存、遺失只是假想的可能，用 might have been lost forever（也可 would otherwise have been lost）；「這讓…能看見」承接前句用 , which allows… to；「祖先的生活」譯成 how their ancestors lived 較自然（也可 the lives of their ancestors）。信心 medium 是因為「可能永遠遺失」的時態（might be lost／might have been lost）有不同寫法。

1.translation: The reason we need digital archives is simple: no matter how carefully we preserve paper documents, they will eventually deteriorate.
1.explanation_zh: 「我們需要數位典藏的原因」用 The reason (that/why) we need digital archives，省略關係詞；冒號後面接說明。「無論多麼小心保存」用 no matter how carefully 引導讓步副詞子句（也可寫 however carefully），主詞用 we 讓保存的動作更明確。「終究會損壞」用 will eventually deteriorate；deteriorate 比 be damaged 更貼近紙張老化變質的意思。

2.translation: Digital archives have preserved many old photos that might otherwise be lost forever, which allows the younger generation to see how their ancestors lived.
2.explanation_zh: 「保存了」用現在完成式 have preserved，因為保存的成果持續到現在。「可能永遠遺失的老照片」用 old photos that might otherwise be lost forever 的限定關係子句，otherwise 帶出「若不是這樣就會」的意思；也可以不加 otherwise。「這讓年輕一代能看見祖先的生活」用 which allows ... to see ... 的非限定子句，「祖先的生活」譯成 how their ancestors lived（也可寫 their ancestors' lives）。

status_reason: 判定者人工檢查退回（record_verification 判 verified）：第 1 句第 3 部分「保存紙本文件」的 accepted 收了 one preserve／one store／one keep／one protect／one save／one look after／one take care of／one handle + paper documents 等 40 種主詞動詞不一致的錯誤寫法（主詞 one 動詞要加 s），評分規準把文法錯誤當成正確；同一部分又收 we preserve them、they are preserved、we keep them 等不含「紙本文件」的寫法，和第 4 部分 they will eventually be damaged 合起來，整句完全沒譯「紙本文件」仍四個部分全拿。重生後仍不過，停在 rejected。
